FROM 
    dim_presentation dp

SELECT

    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fa.is_banked THEN 0 ELSE fa.score END) / COUNT(DISTINCT fa.student_key), 1) AS avg_tma_score

    fact_assessment_submission fa
JOIN 
    dim_presentation dp ON fa.presentation_key = dp.presentation_key
WHERE 
    fa.assessment_type = 'TMA' AND fa.is_banked = 0
GROUP BY 
    dpm.code_module

FROM 
    fact_assessment_submission fs
JOIN 
    dim_assessment da ON fs.assessment_key = da.assessment_key
GROUP BY 
    da.activity_type

SELECT

SELECT 
    d.asessment_key AS id_assessment,
    d.due_day AS due_day,
    ROUND(SUM(f.score) / COUNT(f.id_assessment), 1) AS mean_score
FROM 
    dim_assessment d
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission f ON d.assessment_key = f.assessment_key AND f.is_banked = 0
WHERE 
    d.code_presentation = 'AAA-2013J'
GROUP BY 
    d.asessment_key, d.due_day

WITH RECURSIVE module_subtotals AS (
    SELECT 
        code_module,
        code_presentation,
        SUM(total_clicks) AS total_clicks
    FROM 
        agg_pres_week_activity
    GROUP BY 
        code_module, code_presentation
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        m.code_module,
        m.code_presentation,
        s.total_clicks
    FROM 
        module_subtotals m
    JOIN 
        agg_pres_week_activity s ON m.code_module = s.code_module AND m.code_presentation = s.code_presentation
)
SELECT 
    code_module,
    code_presentation,
    total_clicks
FROM 
    module_subtotals
GROUP BY 
    code_module, code_presentation
WITH ROLLUP

SELECT 
    dp.module_presentation,
    ROUND(SUM(faw.total_clicks) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.student_key), 1) AS avg_total_clicks_per_student
FROM 
    dim_presentation dp
JOIN 
    agg_pres_week_activity aw ON dp.presentation_key = aw.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_enrollment e ON aw.enrollment_key = e.enrollment_key
GROUP BY 
    dp.module_presentation
ORDER BY 
    avg_total_clicks_per_student DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    dpa.code_module,
    da.activity_type,
    COUNT(das.id_assessment) AS count
FROM 
    dim_presentation dp
JOIN 
    dim_assessment das ON dp.presentation_key = das.presentation_key
JOIN 
    dim_activity da ON das.assessment_key = da.activity_key
GROUP BY 
    dp.code_module, da.activity_type

SELECT 
    dpm.code_module,
    ROUND(AVG(das.days_from_due), 1) AS avg_days_late
FROM 
    dim_presentation dp
JOIN 
    dim_assessment da ON dp.presentation_key = da.presentation_key
JOIN 
    fact_assessment_submission das ON da.assessment_key = das.assessment_key AND dp.code_presentation = das.code_presentation
WHERE 
    das.is_late = 1
GROUP BY 
    dp.code_module
